howto.name: Upload a PDF or start blank
howto.text: Upload an existing PDF to add form fields on top, or start with a blank page.

howto.name: Add form fields
howto.text: Drag text inputs, checkboxes, dropdowns, radio buttons, or signature fields onto the page. Set field names and validation rules.

howto.name: Configure form properties
howto.text: Set tab order, default values, and required-field flags. Preview the form to test interactivity.

howto.name: Export the fillable PDF
howto.text: Click Save. The PDF contains standard AcroForm fields that work in any PDF reader.

faq.q: What field types can I add?
faq.a: Text inputs, text areas, checkboxes, radio buttons, dropdowns, date pickers, and signature fields.

faq.q: Will the form work in Adobe Reader?
faq.a: Yes. The forms use the standard AcroForm format, which is compatible with Adobe Reader, Foxit, and all major PDF viewers.

faq.q: Can I set fields as required?
faq.a: Yes. Mark any field as required to prevent submission without filling it in. You can also set validation rules like numeric-only or email format.
